provides: index.html at the repository root with doctype, lang, charset, viewport, title, a strict Content-Security-Policy meta, skip link, <main id="main"> landmark and a footer linking the legal pages
tokens.css (color roles with automatic dark mode, spacing, fluid type, radii) and styles.css (focus-visible, 24px targets, reduced motion), linked from index.html
legal/aviso-legal.html, legal/politica-privacidad.html and legal/politica-cookies.html: provisional Spanish drafts with [PENDIENTE] markers, linked from the footer
_headers and docs/operations/{security-headers.md,Caddyfile.snippet}: full HTTP security header set (CSP with frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
scripts/check.mjs validating pages: links, CSP, no inline script/style/handlers, safe target=_blank, no http:// or external assets, AA token contrast; warns on [PENDIENTE] markers
npm test runs node --test (place tests as test/**/*.test.mjs, node:test + node:assert, no extra dependencies)
npm run check runs scripts/check.mjs and then the tests
ui-routes.json at the root with the default ["/"]: a JSON array of absolute route paths captured by the browser (keep this exact format)
